description_en: Adds a face image to a specified face library
description_zh: 添加人脸图片到指定人脸库
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl add-face-record --face-group-code sgl00007uc --product-code FACE_ENROLL --merchant-user-id 130A2C10B9EE4D8488E35384FF03hst --face-picture base64 --face-picture-url https://www.xxxxx.com/test.jpg --face-picture-file InputStream --face-quality-check N --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddFaceRecord

parameters.description_en:
The custom unique user ID. The value cannot exceed 32 characters.
- If this parameter is specified, the system registers the user with the specified MerchantUserId.
- If this parameter is not specified, the image name is used by default.
parameters.description_zh:
自定义的用户唯一ID，不能超过32位。
- 若客户传入优先以该MerchantUserId注册；
- 若未传入默认选图片名

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the quality of the face image. Valid values:
- Y: enabled.
- N: disabled (default).
parameters.description_zh:
是否检测人脸图片质量
- Y：开启
- N：关闭（默认）
